description: Ministry of Public Administration P.C. and L.G  - Pilgrimages ordinance Regulations - Amendment

This constitutes a modification to existing legal/regulatory instruments, falling squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which include "legal amendments, repeals, or modifications" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While a minister's name and title are present, they are part of the notification's signature block and do not constitute the primary subject of the gazette, which is the regulatory amendment itself.
